products.title: Store Ops Pack
products.summary: Six skills for the Shopify jobs that eat the week, in one download.
products.tested: Every skill in the pack was tested on real public Shopify stores or real public merchant cases and scored against a written rubric. Each ships only when every test scores 8/10 or more.

products.title: Agent-Ready Store Audit
products.summary: A 0 to 100 score for how AI shopping agents read your store, with the top 7 fixes.
products.give: Your store URL.
products.get: A score out of 100 for how well AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and others) can find, understand and buy from your store, an agent's-eye test of real buyer questions, and a ranked fix list.
products.tested: Tested on 4 real public Shopify stores. Final runs: 9, 9, 9.5 and 9 out of 10.

products.title: BFCM Campaign Kit
products.summary: Offer maths on your real prices, a dated calendar, 5 emails, 3 SMS and an ops checklist.
products.give: Your store URL (plus your margin, if you know it).
products.get: A Black Friday / Cyber Monday plan: offer maths on your real prices, a dated US/UK calendar, 5 emails, 3 SMS, banners and an ops checklist. No fake urgency.
products.tested: Tested on 4 real public Shopify stores (US and UK, low to high price points). Final version: 9/10 on all four.

products.title: Chargeback Response Writer
products.summary: A dispute response matched to the reason code. It never invents evidence.
products.give: The dispute details plus the evidence you actually have.
products.get: A response matched to the reason code, a checklist of what to attach, and a list of gaps. It never invents evidence, and it tells you when accepting is cheaper.
products.tested: Tested on 6 real dispute scenarios from the Shopify Community forum. Every final run scored 9/10 or more, with no invented evidence.

products.title: Product Description Rewriter
products.summary: Clean Shopify HTML descriptions with an SEO title and meta description, for one product or a collection.
products.give: A product URL, pasted text, a collection, or your product export CSV.
products.get: Clean Shopify HTML descriptions with an SEO title (≤ 60 characters) and meta description (≤ 155). Bulk runs produce an import CSV.
products.tested: Tested on 4 real public Shopify stores and one product export CSV. Final scores: 9, 9, 10, 10 and 9 out of 10.

products.title: Product SEO Fixer
products.summary: A prioritised fix list with the exact text to paste, for a product, a collection or a product export CSV.
products.give: A product URL, a collection URL, or your product export CSV.
products.get: A prioritised SEO fix list with the exact text to paste and where. Collection mode also writes the collection intro and SEO fields; CSV mode returns a re-importable CSV.
products.tested: Tested on 5 real public Shopify stores across all three modes. Final runs scored 9 to 10 out of 10.

products.title: Support Macro Writer
products.summary: Ready-to-import replies built from your real shipping and returns policies.
products.give: Your store URL.
products.get: It reads your real refund and shipping policies and writes ready-to-import support replies, starting with the hard cases: stuck in transit, "delivered" but not received, address changes, cancellations.
products.tested: Tested on 4 real public Shopify stores with Gorgias, Zendesk, Shopify Inbox and neutral output, scored against a written rubric. Every policy fact in the macros was checked against the stores' own policy text.

products.title: Agent-Ready Quick Check
products.summary: Six checks on how AI shopping agents read your store, compared with 99 stores we audited.
products.give: Your store URL.
products.get: A 6-check scorecard of how well AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude) can read your store. Each check is compared with 99 Shopify stores we audited in October 2026.
products.tested: Tested on 4 real public Shopify stores. Final runs: 9.5/10 on all four.

products.title: Alt Text Writer
products.summary: Alt text for every product image, written while looking at the photo, as an import CSV.
products.give: Your store URL, a product URL, or your product export CSV.
products.get: Alt text for every product image, written while looking at the photo. Comes as a Shopify import CSV, a review sheet, and a paste-by-hand list for products with variant images.
products.tested: Tested on 6 real cases from public Shopify stores, including three product export CSVs. Final scores: 10, 10, 9, 10, 9 and 10 out of 10.

products.title: Chargeback Evidence Checklist
products.summary: Got a chargeback? The evidence to gather for your dispute reason, what you already have, and where to find each piece in Shopify.
products.give: The dispute reason.
products.get: The evidence to gather for that reason, what you already have, and where to find each piece in Shopify.
products.tested: Tested on 6 real disputes from the Shopify Community forum. Release-version scores: 9, 9, 9.5, 9, 9 and 9.5 out of 10, plus one Opus check at 9. The paste-in prompt scored 8.5 in Claude.

products.title: Policy Checker
products.summary: Policy gaps and contradictions across refund, shipping, privacy and terms, with fixes to paste.
products.give: Your store URL.
products.get: A scored audit of your refund, shipping, privacy, terms and contact policies. It flags missing items and contradictions with your FAQ and banners, and gives fixes you can paste.
products.tested: Tested on 4 real public Shopify stores. Final scores: 10, 10, 9 and 9 out of 10.

products.title: Product Title Cleaner
products.summary: One consistent title pattern across the catalogue, as an import CSV of changed rows only.
products.give: Your store, a collection URL, or a product export CSV.
products.get: One consistent title pattern across your catalogue, as a `URL handle,Title` import CSV (changed rows only). It never creates duplicate titles.
products.tested: Tested on 3 real public Shopify catalogues, up to 490 products. Final scores: 10, 9 and 10 out of 10.

products.title: Review Reply Drafter
products.summary: A reply for every review, matched to its tone, with the risky ones flagged for you.
products.give: Your reviews (pasted, CSV, or a public review page).
products.get: A reply for each review, matched to its tone. It never promises refunds you didn't approve, and it flags reviews that need you personally.
products.tested: Tested on 3 real public review sets (Judge.me and Trustpilot). Final runs: 9, 9.5 and 9 out of 10.

products.title: Late Payment Chaser (UK)
products.summary: One unpaid invoice in. The statutory interest and fixed recovery sum worked out with a script, and three reminder emails out. UK business debts only.
products.give: One unpaid business invoice (amount, invoice date, and the due date if you agreed one).
products.get: What you can claim under UK late-payment law, with the working and official sources, and three reminder emails to send.
products.tested: 3 real tests built on the facts of published UK court judgments. Figures checked by hand against the script and the judgment.

products.title: Host Ops Pack
products.summary: Six skills for the listing, review and house-rules jobs of hosts who run their own listings.
products.tested: Each of the six skills has 4 tests on real public data, scored by hand against a written rubric. On the latest Claude Sonnet run of each test, every score is 8.5 or 9 out of 10. An independent reviewer re-scored 12 tests and ran 10 fresh cases from another city; every defect it listed as required is fixed in this version. No host has used the output on a live listing yet.

products.title: Listing Rewriter
products.summary: Three titles under 50 characters and a description within 500, built only from your own facts.
products.give: Paste your listing title, description and amenities.
products.get: Three titles under 50 characters, a description within 500 characters and the section fields, built only from your own facts, plus a list of anything to confirm.
products.tested: Tested on 4 real public listings. Final Claude Sonnet scores: 9, 8.5, 9 and 8.5 out of 10.

products.title: AI Search Readiness Check
products.summary: Can ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google read a website? A score out of 100 from 8 checks, the evidence and the fixes in order.
products.give: A website URL.
products.get: A 0 to 100 score from 8 checks on whether AI search tools can read the site, the evidence for each check, and a fix list in order.
products.tested: Tested on 8 real public websites, as a skill and (four of them) as a pasted prompt, two also on a second model, then re-scored after two independent reviews. The score matched our script in every run. Final scores: 8.5, 8.5, 8.5, 8.5, 9, 9, 9 and 9 out of 10.

products.title: Search Intent Page Brief
products.summary: Give it a keyword and the pages that rank. Get the search intent, a coverage table, the gaps and an outline. Free, MIT-licensed.
products.give: A target keyword and the three to five pages that rank for it (URLs, or pasted headings).
products.get: It records each page's structure, classifies the search intent from what ranks, builds a coverage table with counts, names the gaps as its own judgement, and drafts an outline, questions to answer and a meta description.
products.tested: 1 real-data run on three public how-to pages (Claude Sonnet). One was blocked and the run handled it honestly.

products.title: Accessibility Quick Audit
products.summary: Give it a page's HTML or components. Get accessibility issues ranked by impact, with the WCAG criterion, the code and a fix. Free, MIT-licensed.
products.give: A URL, pasted HTML or component files.
products.get: It checks text alternatives, form labels, link and button names, headings and landmarks, keyboard and focus, ARIA, contrast where the colours are visible, media and zoom.
products.tested: 1 real-data run on a public demo page built with known accessibility faults (Claude Sonnet). Issues traced to quoted lines.

products.title: Changelog from Commits
products.summary: Give it a commit range or a pasted git log. Get a user-facing changelog with the commit behind every line, and the vague commits flagged.
products.give: A commit range or a pasted git log.
products.get: Get a user-facing changelog with the commit behind every line, and the vague commits flagged.
products.tested: 1 real-data run on the public Express repository (Claude Sonnet, 15 commits). Every entry matched a commit message; the one vague commit was flagged.

products.title: PR Description and Review Prep
products.summary: Run it on your branch. Get a PR title, summary, risk notes and test plan from the diff, plus the questions a reviewer will ask. Free, MIT-licensed.
products.give: Run it in your repository, or paste a diff.
products.get: A ready-to-paste PR title and summary, risk notes, a test plan from what is stated, and the questions a reviewer is likely to ask.
products.tested: 1 real-data run on four public commits (Claude Sonnet).

products.title: README First-Run Check
products.summary: Point it at a repo. It follows the README like a new user and checks every step against the repo: OK, BROKEN, MISSING or UNVERIFIED, with evidence and the README edits that fix it.
products.give: Point it at a repo.
products.get: It follows the README like a new user and checks every step against the repo: OK, BROKEN, MISSING or UNVERIFIED, with evidence and the README edits that fix it.
products.tested: 1 real-data run on a public MDN tutorial repository (Claude Sonnet). The missing start script, the .nvmrc version and the stale Create React App text were all real.

products.title: Test Gap Finder
products.summary: Give it a diff and the tests. Get each behaviour the change adds marked Covered, Not covered or Unknown, and ranked test cases for the gaps.
products.give: A diff and the tests.
products.get: Get each behaviour the change adds marked Covered, Not covered or Unknown, and ranked test cases for the gaps.
products.tested: 1 real-data run on a public multi-hunk change in the Express repository (Claude Sonnet). We checked each Covered and Not covered claim against the tests ourselves.

products.title: Fact-Claim Checker
products.summary: Paste a draft before you publish. Get the claims that need a source, ranked by risk, what would settle each, and safer wording for the ones you cannot back up.
products.give: Paste a draft before you publish.
products.get: Get the claims that need a source, ranked by risk, what would settle each, and safer wording for the ones you cannot back up.
products.tested: 1 real-data run on a public launch post (Claude Sonnet). All 17 flagged claims and both internal conflicts were real.
